spec.name: incident-triage-core
spec.description: A deterministic TypeScript incident normalization, scoring, and triage library used to exercise durable architect-critic collaboration.

operations.name: triageIncident
operations.description: Normalize an incident, calculate its bounded risk, and return a severity and stable summary.
properties: severity is derived only from the documented score boundaries

types.name: IncidentInput
types.definition: { title: unknown; customerImpact: unknown; serviceDown: unknown; securitySignal: unknown }

implementation.composition: Normalize once, call riskScore(normalized.customerImpact, normalized.serviceDown, normalized.securitySignal), map 0-2 low / 3-5 medium / 6-8 high / 9-10 critical, then format `SEVERITY: title (risk score/10)`. The score formula can produce only {0,2,4,5,6,7,8,9,10}; the coarse severity ranges intentionally include unreachable scores 1 and 3.

cases.name: zero-boundary
cases.call: triageIncident({ title: 'Informational', customerImpact: 0, serviceDown: false, securitySignal: false })

cases.name: low-boundary
cases.call: triageIncident({ title: 'Cache warning', customerImpact: 1, serviceDown: false, securitySignal: false })

cases.name: medium-boundary
cases.call: triageIncident({ title: 'Slow API', customerImpact: 2, serviceDown: false, securitySignal: false })

cases.name: medium-upper-boundary
cases.call: triageIncident({ title: 'Security signal', customerImpact: 0, serviceDown: false, securitySignal: true })

cases.name: high-boundary
cases.call: triageIncident({ title: 'Checkout down', customerImpact: 1, serviceDown: true, securitySignal: false })

cases.name: high-upper-boundary
cases.call: triageIncident({ title: 'Broad degradation', customerImpact: 4, serviceDown: false, securitySignal: false })

cases.name: critical-cap
cases.call: triageIncident({ title: '  Breach and outage  ', customerImpact: 9, serviceDown: true, securitySignal: true })

cases.name: critical-nine-security-only
cases.call: triageIncident({ title: 'Credential exposure', customerImpact: 2, serviceDown: false, securitySignal: true })

properties: result.score is always an integer between 0 and 10
the summary contains the normalized title and exact score
the score formula has reachable set {0,2,4,5,6,7,8,9,10}; scores 1 and 3 are intentionally unreachable even though the severity ranges remain contiguous

operations.name: normalizeIncident
operations.description: Normalize title, impact, and boolean flags into a stable value.
properties: customerImpact is truncated toward zero then clamped to 0..5
serviceDown and securitySignal are true only when the input is exactly true; every other value becomes false

types.name: IncidentInput
types.definition: { title: unknown; customerImpact: unknown; serviceDown: unknown; securitySignal: unknown }

types.name: NormalizedIncident
types.definition: { title: string; customerImpact: number; serviceDown: boolean; securitySignal: boolean }

cases.name: trims-and-clamps-high
cases.call: normalizeIncident({ title: '  Outage  ', customerImpact: 9.8, serviceDown: true, securitySignal: false })

cases.name: defaults-and-clamps-low
cases.call: normalizeIncident({ title: '   ', customerImpact: -3, serviceDown: 1, securitySignal: null })

cases.name: truncates-fractional-impact
cases.call: normalizeIncident({ title: 'Partial impact', customerImpact: 2.7, serviceDown: false, securitySignal: false })

operations.name: riskScore
operations.signature: riskScore(customerImpact: number, serviceDown: boolean, securitySignal: boolean) -> number
operations.description: Calculate the documented additive risk score and cap it at 10.
properties: customerImpact contributes two points per level
outage contributes four and security contributes five
